composite_note: South Africa's 'Physical Sciences' is a single subject combining Physics and Chemistry with no Biology. Cambridge HAS carried exactly that combination - IGCSE Physical Science 0652, whose content is Chemistry sections plus Physics sections and nothing else - but it is being WITHDRAWN, with November 2026 as its final examination series. After that, no single Cambridge qualification matches the South African combination: the multi-science awards (0653 Combined, 0654 Co-ordinated Double) all include Biology, and at AS & A Level there is no combined science option at all. The primary mapping is therefore the Physics + Chemistry PAIR taken as two separate subjects - the only mapping that survives the withdrawal and the only one available at Advanced level.
